COLDWAR_SPR_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_initialized
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = SPR_idea_the_eta_1 } } add_ideas = SPR_idea_the_eta_1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = labour_unions } } add_ideas = labour_unions set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = 35 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = farmers } } add_ideas = farmers set_variable = { farmers_opinion = 40 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = landowners } } add_ideas = landowners set_variable = { landowners_opinion = 60 } }
		initialize_internal_faction_dynamic_modifiers = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = SPR_culture_opinion^0 } }
			clear_array = SPR_culture_opinion
			add_to_array = { SPR_culture_opinion = 60 }
			add_to_array = { SPR_culture_opinion = 35 }
			add_to_array = { SPR_culture_opinion = 45 }
			add_to_array = { SPR_culture_opinion = 70 }
			add_to_array = { SPR_culture_opinion = 65 }
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_state_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_economy_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_army_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_security_modifier }
		set_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop left_side = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop_continuismo_side right_side = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop_apertura_side set_value = -0.35 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value = -0.35 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.1 days = 2149 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 3 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half = 0 }
		COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = yes
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_regime } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_regime }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_democracy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_democracy }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_regime } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_regime }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_democracy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_democracy }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_regime } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_regime }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_democracy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_democracy }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_regime } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_regime }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_democracy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_democracy }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_democracy }
		else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_1_regime }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_democracy }
		else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_2_regime }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_democracy }
		else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_3_regime }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_democracy }
		else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_4_regime }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_up = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_up_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage < 4 } }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.3 days = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 4 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.4 days = 1 } }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half = 0 }
		COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_down = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_down_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_floor = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_vertical_syndicate } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_floor = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage > COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_floor } }
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half = 0 }
		COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half_up = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half_up_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half > 0 } } COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_up = yes }
		else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_half = 1 } }
	}

COLDWAR_SPR_allow_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_allow_elections_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_free_elections
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes } }
		COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SPR_ban_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_ban_elections_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = no } }
		COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_refresh = yes
	}
}

	}

COLDWAR_SPR_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_franco_dead } date > 1975.11.21 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_spanish_miracle has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > 1.99 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement_USA_paused country_exists = USA USA = { COLDWAR_SPR_deal_clear_USA = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement_USA_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement }
		USA = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_end_of_base_agreement_USA }
		USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union_POR_paused country_exists = POR POR = { COLDWAR_SPR_deal_clear_POR = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union_POR_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union }
		POR = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_iberian_union_POR }
		POR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SPR.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_deal_southern_sentinels_POR_paused country_exists = POR POR = { COLDWAR_SPR_deal_clear_POR = yes } }
